item.title: 无线图传（WVTS）分类综览
item.description:
flowchart LR
 A[无线图传WVTS<br>Wireless Video Transmission System]

 A --> C[无线电波 RF<br>>99.9% 所有场景]
 A --> D[非无线电波<br>极罕见]

 %% 无线电波大类
 C --> C1[按频谱许可划分]
 C --> C2[按调制技术划分]
 C --> C3[按典型应用场景划分]

 C1 --> C11[免许可频段 ISM/业余]
 C1 --> C12[需许可频段 专业/军用]

 C11 --> c111[2.4 GHz<br>Wi-Fi、DJI OcuSync/Lightbridge]
 C11 --> c112[5.8 GHz<br>FPV主流、DJI O3、Walksnail、HDZero]
 C11 --> c113[1.2/1.3 GHz<br>长距穿透]
 C11 --> c114[433/868/915 MHz<br>ELRS、Crossfire超远距]
 C11 --> c115[60 GHz mmWave<br>短距超高带宽]

 C12 --> c121[C波段 4-8 GHz\<br>Vislink、BMI、Domo]
 C12 --> c122[Ku/Ka波段<br>卫星、军用无人机]
 C12 --> c123[L/S/X等军用专用]

 C2 --> C21[模拟 Analog]
 C2 --> C22[数字 Digital]
 C2 --> C23[模拟+数字混合]

 C21 --> c211[传统FM<br>Raceband老FPV]
 C21 --> c212[增强模拟<br>SmartAudio、TBS Fusion]

 C22 --> c221[Wi-Fi基<br>老DJI、GoPro、手机投屏]
 C22 --> c222[专有协议<br>DJI O3/O4、Walksnail、HDZero、Amimon、Herelink]
 C22 --> c223[COFDM<br>Silvus、Domo、TrellisWare、L3Harris]
 C22 --> c224[LTE/5G<br>LiveU、TVU、5G私网]
 C22 --> c225[卫星<br>Starlink、BGAN、WGS]

 C23 --> c231[Caddx Vista、DJI Air Unit 等可切换方案]

 C3 --> c31[消费/FPV级<br><50ms 超低延迟]
 C3 --> c32[电影航拍级<br>DJI Transmission、Teradek]
 C3 --> c33[工业巡检级<br>高可靠]
 C3 --> c34[军用/战术级<br>抗干扰、加密、LPI/LPD]

 %% 非无线电波
 D --> d1[自由空间光 FSO<br>激光/红外，军用头盔]
 D --> d2[太赫兹<br>实验室]
 D --> d3[水下声波图传]
